name: Model Disagreement Sampler
description: Selects experimental conditions where multiple models show the greatest prediction disagreement, useful for identifying informative experiments.

parameters.name: num_samples
parameters.description: Number of samples to select where models disagree most.

inputDataType.name: conditions
inputDataType.description: Pool of candidate experimental conditions to evaluate.

inputDataType.name: models
inputDataType.description: List of trained sklearn models to compare predictions.

outputDataType.name: conditions
outputDataType.description: Selected conditions with highest model disagreement.
